🎯 Prepare goals with managers before publishing the cycle

 

New

  

You can now involve managers in creating goals while the cycle is still in draft. This way, the People team can prepare the upcoming cycle in advance and publish it when it’s ready.

✨ What’s included?

  • Invite managers to define their team’s goals before the cycle is visible to the entire organization.
  • Managers receive a notificaation with direct access to the cycle from the employee portal.
  • The employee portal displays a pending task for those who haven’t addded their goals yet, so they don’t miss the deadline.
  • Check the cycle status and the perdentage of managers who have already completed their goals from a dedicated cycle space.

💡 Why is it useful?

  • Reduces last-minute work when launching a new cycle.
  • Helps ensure goals are pepare and aligned before they are published.
  • Gives the People team visibility into progress and makes it easier to track pending tasks.

👥 Share reviews across the entire manager chain

 

New

  

Managers can now access the review history of all their direct and indirect reports, providing a more complete view of their teams’ development and performance.

Until now, the option to share previous reviews only allowed the current manager to access the history of their direct reports. With this improvement, it is also possible to extend that access throught the entire reporting structure.

🔧 What does this improvement include?

  • A new option to share reviews with the entire manager chain.
  • Managers of managers can access the evaluations of contributors who are part of their structure, even if they aren ot direct reports.
  • Access can be managed from the evaluation visibility settings.
  • From each person’s profile panel, you can view their reporting structure and check which reviews are shared.

🎯 Why is it useful?

  • Gives managers a more complete view of the talent within their area of responsibility.
  • Makes it easier to track the development of teams with hierarchical structures.
  • Prevents historical information from being lost when moving up a level in the management structure.

With this improvement, the reviews history can follow people throughout the entire manager chain, maintaining the context needed to make better talent decisions.

🔐 Specific permissions for the Whistleblowing channel

 

New

  

You can now grant access to the whistleblowing channel independently, providing greater control over who can manage this type of communication.

Until now, access was limited and no specific permission existed for this feature. With this improvement, you can tailor permissions to match your organization’s structure and responsibilities.

🔧 What does this improvement includes?

  • A new specific permission to access the whistleblowing channel.
  • The ability to grant access to the channel without needing to provide access to the feedback module.
  • Users with only this permission will exclusively see messages from the whistleblowing channel

🎯 Why is this useful?

  • Allows you to delegate the management of the whistleblowing channel to the right people.
  • Strengthens confidentiality by limiting access to the necessary information.
  • Offers a more flexible permission model tailored to the different roles within your organization.
Product team

💰 Bonus schemes by employee profile

 

New

  

You can now configure different evaluation schemes based on each employee’s bonus profile, adapting the weight of competencies and objectives to each group within the organization.

Not all roles are evaluated in the same way. With this improvement, Nailted makes it easy to reflect that reality in a simple and centralized manner.

🔧 What does this improvement include?

  • A new ‘Bonus type’ attribute for employees.
  • The ability to import and update this attribute in bulk using CSV files.
  • A new configuration section to create, edit, and manage the different bonus types.
  • Each bonus type can have its own weighting between competences and goals, which will be automatically applied to the associated employees.

🎯 Why is this useful?

  • Allows you to tailor the review model to different professional profiles.
  • Simplifies the management of bonus without the need to create separate campaigns.
  • Ensures that the final review calculation is aligned with the criteris of each employee groups. .

With this improvement, organizations can customize their reviews to better reflect the reality of each role and its compensation model.

Product team

👥 Share evaluation history with current managers

 

New

  

You can now decide whether managers have access only to the evaluations they have completed themselves or to the full evaluation history of their direct reports.

In many organizations, changes in management can make it difficult to track an employee’s development over time. With this enhancement, new managers have more context to better support and develop their teams.

🔧 What’s included in this enhacement?

  • A new visibility setting within each campaign.
  • Two available options:
    • Default: Managers can only view the reviews they have personally completed.
    • Shared: Managers can access the full evaluation history of their direct reports, including reviews completed by previous managers.

🎯 Why is this useful?

  • Makes transitions smoother when an employee changes managers.
  • Ensures continuity in development and performance review process.
  • Helps managers better understan the progression of their team members with a more complete historical view.

With this enhacement, managers can make better-informed decisions and support their direct report’s growth with greater context.

💡 Manager tips for 1:1 meetings

 

New

  

You can now add guidance and recommendations for managers directly within 1:1 meeting templates, helping them prepare for and lead more effective conversations.

Until now, templates helped structure the meeting agenda but did not provide specific guidance on how to approach particular topics.

🔧 What’s included?

  • A new optional “Nuevo campo opcional de “Manager tips” dentro de las plantillas de 1:1.
  • Allows you to add recommendations, best practices, or suggested questions for managers.
  • Tips are displayed directly within the meeting, alongside the rest of the template content.

🎯 Why is it useful?

  • Helps managers conduct more consistent and higher quality conversations.
  • Encourages the adoption of best practices across the organization.
  • Reduces reliance on external training materials or documentation when preparing for meetings.

With this enhancement, 1:1 templates do more than structure the conversation, they also help ensure it happens in the most effective way possible.

📄 Goal PDF Reports

 

New

  

You can now generate a PDF report containing all of an employee’s goals, making it easier to track progress, maintain documentation, and support audit processes.

This report consolidates all the relevant information about the goals assigned to an employee during a cycle into a single document.

🔧 What’s included?

  • All of the employee’s goals in one document.
  • Key information such as:
    • Goals and descriptions
    • Progress achieved
    • Relevant dates
    • Involved roles (employee and manager)
  • Available at any time, both at the **start of the cyle ****and upon *completion*.

🎯 Why is it useful?

  • Simplifies the review, approval, and sign-off process at the beginning of the cycle.
  • Provides a clear record of results and progress achieve at the end of the cycle.
  • Helps meet audit requirements and supports internal talent management processes.

With this enhacement, goals can be easily shared, achieved, reviewed, and even signed in a standard, professional format.

🏆 Competences ranking

 

New

  

You can now easily see who stands out the most, and the least, in each competence within a campaign.

Until now, analytics made it possible to understand overall trends, but not to quichly identify the people with the highest or lowest results in a specific competency. With this improvement, that information is now directly accesible.

🔧 What does this improvement include?

  • New ranking list available within the Competency Heatmap.
  • Visualization of:
    • Top 10 people with the highest scores
    • Bottom 10 people with the lowest scores
  • Automatically sorted by the selected competence rating.
  • Option to display people in the middle of the ranking when additional context is needed.

🎯 Why is it useful?

  • Quickly identifies strenghts and development areas within the organization.
  • Facilitates calibration conversations and development decisions.
  • Helps identify internal role models for specific competencies.

With this improvement, campaigns provide a more actionable and comparative view of talent across each competency.

⚖️ Configure weights according to the reviewer in campaigns

 

New

  

You can now define how much impact each reviewer type has on the final results of a campaign, enabling more balanced evaluation models tailored to your organization.

Until now, all responses had the same weight in the final calculation. With this improvement, you can decide how much influence each perspective should have in the evaluation.

🔧 What’s included in this improvement?

  • New advanced settings to assign a specific weight to each reviewer type:
    • Self-review
    • Peers
    • Managers
    • Direct reports
  • The total sum of all weights must always equal 100%.
  • A new toggle to enable this calculation model, while maintaining compatibility with previous campaigns that use the classic average model.
  • If weights are modified dduring an active campaign, results are automatially recalculated.

📊 Where does this apply?

Configure weights impact:

  • Campaign results
  • Surveys
  • Final score
  • 9-box
  • Data exports

Additionally, when a campaign uses custom weights, metris clearly indicate that they are using Weighted Average (W. Avg) model.

🎯 Why is this important?

  • Allows greater importane to be given to specific perspectives (for example, managers vs. peers).
  • Reduces bias caused by differences in the number of evaluations received.
  • Makes evaluations better reflecct each company’s performance model.

With this improvement, feedback campaigns become more flexible, fair, and aligned with the reality of each organization.

👥 Compare results across People

 

New

  

You can now compare performance results between different people within the same campaign, providing a clearer and more contextual view of performance.

🔧 What’s included in this improvement?

  • A new employee selector to choose who to compare against.
  • The ability to visualize multiple people’s results in the same radar chart.
  • When starting a comparison, the chart automatically adjusts to display average values, ensuring a fairer and more consistent comparison.

🎯 Why is this useful?

  • Helps better understand relative performance across team members.
  • Enables more informed calibration conversations.
  • Makes it easier to spot differences and patterns quickly through visual comparison.

With this improvement, performane analysis evolves from being individual to becoming comparative an contextual.
